label: TP
reason: User-supplied cookie value flows through URL decoding into a variable used as input to MessageDigest digest operation. The resulting bytes are converted back to a string via new String(byte[]) and passed directly to encodeForHTML(), which outputs unescaped HTML to the response stream. This constitutes an XSS vector where attacker-controlled input reaches the browser.

evidence.note: Flow from getUserCookie getValue -> decode -> input -> new String(input) -> encodeForHTML -> response.getWriter()
